blocks.html: Growth Rate is a metric that measures the percentage increase or decrease in a company’s revenue, customers, market share, or other key performance indicators over a specific period of time.

Growth Rate is used to evaluate business performance trends and track progress toward strategic goals. It helps organizations understand whether they are expanding, remaining stable, or declining. Companies commonly monitor growth rates across sales, customer acquisition, profits, website traffic, and market presence to guide planning and investment decisions.

A company generated ₹10 crore in revenue last year and ₹12 crore this year. Its revenue growth rate would be 20%, indicating healthy year-over-year expansion.

Growth Rate is a fundamental metric for understanding business momentum and long-term success. By regularly tracking growth across key areas, companies can make smarter decisions, improve strategy, and sustain competitive advantage.
